strafer.name: goBILDA Strafer kit · 96, 104 and 140 mm mecanum wheels
strafer.credit: CAD: goBILDA Strafer 3209-0001-0007 as assembled by the team, with a REV Control Hub, goBILDA Pinpoint and 4-Bar pods; goBILDA 140 mm and 96 mm mecanum wheels. Curated wheel animation; visual model only.
strafer.orientation: Source +Y is front, +Z is up; exported in the app robot frame. The shown wheel set touches the floor.
strafer.assetNote: Open CASCADE meshes the same STEP slightly differently on each operating system, so each prepared build's hash is listed. The kit with three wheel sets has been prepared on Apple Silicon macOS only so far; preparing it on Windows adds its hash here.
